articles.title: U.S. agency hits Utah with lawsuit to shield Kalshi's ability to offer betting there
articles.snippet: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has pursued more than a dozen legal actions to protect what its chief sees as its sole power over prediction markets.

articles.title: Phantom launches Kalshi-powered prediction markets for US users
articles.snippet: The crypto wallet’s new integration offers CFTC-regulated event contracts through Kalshi, as prediction markets face growing legal challenges in the US.

articles.title: Settlement concerns prompt Euronext to halt CoinShares’ Zcash ETP ahead of debut
articles.snippet: A Euronext spokesperson told Cointelegraph the suspension was due to “operational settlement requirements” and remains in effect until settlement operations are supported by the CSD.

articles.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll
articles.snippet: The September survey offered a possible window into US voters who could consider fintech and digital asset policies on Election Day.

articles.title: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
articles.snippet: The blockchain-based fund offers eligible non-US investors exposure to the Nasdaq-100 as Janus Henderson expands its institutional tokenization business.
